title: What's next for Shedeur Sanders? NFL sources question whether Browns QB has a starting future

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: What's next for Shedeur Sanders? NFL sources question whether Browns QB has a starting future
sources.description: After Deshaun Watson won Cleveland's starting job, NFL coaches and front-office officials explain why Sanders faces an uncertain future -- and why some teams wouldn't trade for him even if he became available
